mechanical_discovery_refs: ء ر ض B007 ↔ ق د م B006
ق د م B006 ↔ ن ف س B013
new_or_upgraded_candidates.reason: The lament is structurally about a failed undertaking: intention existed as a moral possibility but was never converted into forward action. Because قَدَّمْتُ explicitly names advance and the first-person suffix fixes responsibility in the self, initiative is a strong secondary abstraction. Martial courage and an actual charge against an enemy remain inactive details.

The direct counterfactual lament after belated remembrance supplies a local emotional trigger for inward contraction, shame, and regret. This is stronger than a generic Furūq association because the speech openly acknowledges the speaker's own failure to prepare. Modesty as a stable virtue is not asserted, so the branch is not raised to B.

alternate_mechanisms.name: cosmic_indication_becomes_self_testimony
alternate_mechanisms.summary: The scene first communicates nonverbally: crushed earth, sovereign arrival, and presented Hell make reality evidentially manifest. Perception turns that indication into remembrance, and remembrance then becomes public, accountable self-testimony about the deed that was not advanced.

alternate_mechanisms.name: belated_revaluation_of_true_life
alternate_mechanisms.summary: The counterfactual confession corrects the speaker's former valuation: true life is finally recognized as the precious saving good, concern becomes explicit, and shame attaches to the failure to turn inward intention into prior moral initiative. The correction arrives only after temporal leeway has closed.

alternate_mechanisms.name: coercive_bond_versus_trustful_stability
alternate_mechanisms.summary: Sovereign judgment fixes one subject through an imposed, unbreakable bond, while the final vocative addresses a self already made stable by security and trust. The shared firmness field divides according to relation: external compulsion on one side, inward reliance on the other.

alternate_mechanisms.name: ordered_authority_drives_unavoidable_disclosure
alternate_mechanisms.summary: The collapse of earthly footing occurs under visibly coordinated authority: the angelic collective is ordered, Hell is compelled into presentation, and the human is left exposed before an encounter that cannot be evaded. Remembrance follows because organized manifestation has removed every remaining shelter for denial.

alternate_mechanisms.name: unmatched_agency_and_individualized_outcome
alternate_mechanisms.summary: The repeated exhaustive negation establishes unmatched punitive and binding agency, but it also distributes the terminal encounter individual by individual. The passage then pivots from generic الإنسان and anyone/no one to direct address of a particular kind of self, making inward character the basis of the contrasting outcome.
